Name: Dune Wastes
FlavorText: Endless sand under a sky the wrong color. Something out there moves under the dunes, and it's already found you.

Name: Rot Marsh
FlavorText: The mud never dries and nothing here rots all the way. Every step forward is a step something else can smell.

Name: Frozen Reach
FlavorText: Wind-scoured ice stretches to the horizon. The cold isn't the only thing hunting you out here.

Name: Overgrown Canopy
FlavorText: Vines swallow whatever crashes here within a season. The canopy is thick enough to hide anything that wants to stay hidden.

Name: Ashen Caldera
FlavorText: Heat rises off cracked rock in visible waves. Whatever nests this close to the caldera doesn't fear fire — it uses it.

Name: Derelict Hull
FlavorText: A ship that crashed long before yours did, picked clean and re-inhabited. The wreckage remembers every crew that didn't make it out.

Name: Shallow Reef
FlavorText: Tide pools glitter over a reef that never goes fully quiet. Low water means nowhere left to hide from what's underneath.

Name: Shuttle
FlavorText: Scorched but intact, exactly where you left it. No fight left here — just the walk up the ramp.
